recognize_zh: 周邊血中有大量中至大型淋巴細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質中度濃縮，可見單一清楚的中央核仁，細胞質中等量、淡藍色，這種「有核仁的中大型淋巴球」為主體是 B 細胞前淋巴球性白血病（B-PLL）的樣貌。
features: Numerous medium-to-large lymphoid cells, about twice the diameter of a red cell
Round to oval, occasionally irregular or angulated nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Single distinct central nucleolus visible in several cells
Moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm, some with fine vacuoles and small blebs
Relatively uniform population without small mature CLL-type lymphocytes or smudge cells in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous circulating medium-to-large lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and a single distinct central nucleolus in many cells. The cells have a moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm, occasionally with fine vacuoles or small blebs. Small mature lymphocytes and smudge cells are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with a prolymphocytic proliferation of B-cell type (B-prolymphocytic leukemia), provided the B-cell phenotype is confirmed and mantle cell lymphoma is excluded by cyclin D1/t(11;14) testing.

ddx.dx: Leukemic blastoid or pleomorphic mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Can look identical, so cyclin D1 or SOX11 expression and CCND1 rearrangement must be excluded before diagnosing B-PLL.
Prolymphocytes make up fewer than 55% of lymphoid cells, set in a background of small CLL lymphocytes with smudge cells and a CD5+/CD23+ phenotype.
Cells are smaller with cytoplasmic blebs and prominent nucleoli but express T-cell markers and TCL1 with inv(14)/t(14;14).

ddx.dx: Splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli (HCL variant)
ddx.vs: Cells show more abundant cytoplasm with villous projections and are CD11c/CD103 positive.
